description.value:
Ability Scores: Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.feats.Item.phbftSkilled0000]{Skilled}

Skill Proficiencies: Investigation and Perception

Tool Proficiency: Calligrapher’s Supplies

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbtulCalligraph]{Calligrapher’s Supplies}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagLamp0000000]{Lamp}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Oil} (3 flasks), @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagParchment00]{Parchment} (12 sheets), 23 GP; or (B) 50 GP

You spent formative years in a scriptorium, a monastery dedicated to the preservation of knowledge, or a government agency, where you learned to write with a clear hand and produce finely written texts. Perhaps you scribed government documents or copied tomes of literature. You might have some skill as a writer of poetry, narrative, or scholarly research. Above all, you have a careful attention to detail, helping you avoid introducing mistakes to the documents you copy and create.

advancement.title: Background Ability Score Improvement
advancement.hint: Your background allows you to increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, and Wisdom scores; increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.

advancement.title: Background Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Your background grants you proficiency in Investigation and Perception. It also grants you proficiency with Calligrapher's Supplies.

advancement.title: Background Feat
advancement.hint: Your background grants you the Skilled feat.

advancement.title: Choose Languages
advancement.hint: Your character knows at least three languages: Common plus two languages you roll or choose from the Standard Languages table.
